description: The Proth number k*2^n + 1. k must be odd and strictly less than 2^n. 1*2^1+1 is 3, and 3*2^5+1 is 97. An even k, or a k that is not below 2^n, is rejected. n runs from 1 to 40. Returns JSON with: k, n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/proth
